rules.statement: A lessee who has been put into vacant possession of the property demised cannot, in the absence of an express covenant by the lessor in the lease empowering him to do so, bring his lessor into Court against the latter's will as a defendant to an action brought by him against third parties, not claiming title under the lessor, who have ousted him from possession.
